target_segment: Our core research-driven 25-35 segment - the ones who read the full ingredient list before buying and care about formulation science, not just packaging or influencer hype.
price_posture: Mid-market - not premium, not budget. The price needs to reflect real dermat-reviewed formulation quality without pricing out mid-market Indian buyers.
competitors: Mamaearth is the closest comp in scale and 'toxin-free' positioning, but they're much more mass-market. Sugar Cosmetics is color-cosmetics and Gen-Z voice, not really a direct skincare comp for this one. Plum is probably our real head-to-head - similar ingredient-conscious, clean-beauty buyer - so we need to differentiate clearly against them specifically.
core_message: GlowRoot doesn't just claim clean ingredients - we show you the full formulation and the dermat sign-off behind it, so you can actually verify what you're putting on your skin instead of taking our word for it.
hard_constraints: No benefit-only claims without backing them with the actual ingredient or mechanism - that's the one thing we can never compromise on. Keep the tone informative and warm, not preachy or clinical-cold. And don't overclaim against Plum specifically - we want to differentiate on transparency depth, not disparage them.
primary_goal: We want to convert ingredient-label-readers who are currently loyal to Plum or still comparison-shopping, by proving we go deeper on formulation transparency than anyone else in this price band.
